Simple pancakes

Fluffy pancakes, ready in 25 minutes. Serves four.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups plain flour
  • 2 tablespoons sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1 large egg, beaten
  • 1 1/4 cups whole milk
  • 3 tablespoons melted butter

Method

  1. Whisk the flour, sugar and baking powder in a large bowl.
  2. Beat in the egg, the milk and the melted butter until smooth.
  3. Pour a quarter cup of batter onto a hot greased pan.
  4. Cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook the other side.
